title: Inline shared task editor
html:
Shared task editor

Edit directly in the list
css: .t7-shell{font:13px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif;color:#172033;background:#f7f8fb;border:1px solid #dfe3ea;border-radius:16px;padding:15px;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;max-width:100%;overflow:hidden}.t7-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px}.t7-head p{margin:0;color:#6c7688;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.09em;font-size:10px}.t7-head h2{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:20px}.t7-head button,.t7-actions button,.t7-row>button{appearance:none;border:1px solid #cbd3df;background:white;border-radius:7px;padding:7px 9px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;color:#253047;cursor:pointer}.t7-head button{background:#2447bd;color:white;border-color:#2447bd}.t7-error{margin-bottom:9px;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid #efb9b9;background:#fff1f1;color:#8a2020;border-radius:8px}.t7-list{display:grid;gap:7px}.t7-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.7fr) minmax(90px,.8fr) auto auto auto;gap:8px;align-items:center;background:white;border:1px solid #dde2ea;border-radius:9px;padding:8px 9px;min-width:0}.t7-row strong{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.t7-muted{color:#667186;font-size:11px}.t7-status{font-size:11px;border-radius:999px;background:#eef1f5;padding:3px 8px;white-space:nowrap}.t7-status[data-status="Doing"]{background:#fff3d6;color:#805700}.t7-status[data-status="Done"]{background:#e7f7ee;color:#176b3a}.t7-editrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(150px,2fr) minmax(110px,1fr) minmax(100px,.8fr) minmax(120px,.9fr) auto;gap:7px;align-items:end;background:#f4f7ff;border:1px solid #91a4df;border-radius:9px;padding:9px;min-width:0}.t7-editrow label{display:grid;gap:3px;min-width:0;font-size:10px;color:#5d687b}.t7-editrow input,.t7-editrow select{width:100%;min-width:0;box-sizing:border-box;border:1px solid #bdc7d8;border-radius:7px;padding:7px;background:white;color:#172033;font:inherit}.t7-actions{display:flex;gap:5px;align-items:center}.t7-actions button[data-save]{background:#2447bd;color:white;border-color:#2447bd}.t7-empty{padding:16px;text-align:center;color:#717c8e;background:white;border:1px dashed #cfd6e2;border-radius:9px}@media(max-width:820px){.t7-row{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto auto}.t7-row .t7-owner,.t7-row .t7-due{display:none}.t7-editrow{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.t7-actions{grid-column:1/-1;justify-content:flex-end}}
js: const list=root.querySelector('[data-list]');const error=root.querySelector('[data-error]');const newBtn=root.querySelector('[data-new]');let editingId=null;let creating=false;function allTasks(){return api.getState('tasks')||[];}function clearError(){error.hidden=true;error.textContent='';}function showError(msg){error.textContent=msg;error.hidden=false;}function field(labelText,type,value,options){const label=document.createElement('label');label.textContent=labelText;let input;if(type==='select'){input=document.createElement('select');options.forEach(v=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=v;o.textContent=v;if(v===value)o.selected=true;input.append(o);});}else{input=document.createElement('input');input.type=type;input.value=value||'';}label.append(input);return{label,input};}function editRow(task,isNew){const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='t7-editrow';const title=field('Title','text',task.title);const owner=field('Owner','text',task.owner);const status=field('Status','select',task.status||'Todo',['Todo','Doing','Done']);const due=field('Due date','date',task.due);const actions=document.createElement('div');actions.className='t7-actions';const cancel=document.createElement('button');cancel.type='button';cancel.textContent='Cancel';const save=document.createElement('button');save.type='button';save.dataset.save='';save.textContent=isNew?'Create':'Save';cancel.addEventListener('click',()=>{editingId=null;creating=false;clearError();render();});save.addEventListener('click',()=>{const clean=title.input.value.trim();if(!clean){showError('Title is required. Enter a task title before saving.');title.input.focus();return;}const updated={...task,title:clean,owner:owner.input.value.trim(),status:status.input.value,due:due.input.value};const tasks=allTasks();if(isNew){updated.id='task-'+Date.now().toString(36)+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6);api.setState('tasks',[...tasks,updated]);api.log(7,'Created task '+clean);}else{api.setState('tasks',tasks.map(t=>t.id===task.id?updated:t));api.log(7,'Edited task '+clean);}editingId=null;creating=false;clearError();render();});actions.append(cancel,save);row.append(title.label,owner.label,status.label,due.label,actions);return row;}function displayRow(task){const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='t7-row';const title=document.createElement('strong');title.textContent=task.title||'(untitled)';const owner=document.createElement('span');owner.className='t7-muted t7-owner';owner.textContent=task.owner||'Unassigned';const status=document.createElement('span');status.className='t7-status';status.dataset.status=task.status||'';status.textContent=task.status||'—';const due=document.createElement('span');due.className='t7-muted t7-due';due.textContent=task.due||'No due';const edit=document.createElement('button');edit.type='button';edit.textContent='Edit';edit.addEventListener('click',()=>{creating=false;editingId=task.id;clearError();render();});row.append(title,owner,status,due,edit);return row;}function render(){const tasks=allTasks();const nodes=[];if(creating)nodes.push(editRow({title:'',owner:'',status:'Todo',due:''},true));tasks.forEach(task=>nodes.push(editingId===task.id?editRow({...task},false):displayRow(task)));if(!nodes.length){const empty=document.createElement('div');empty.className='t7-empty';empty.textContent='No tasks yet. Create the first task.';nodes.push(empty);}list.replaceChildren(...nodes);newBtn.disabled=creating;newBtn.textContent=creating?'Creating…':'+ New task';}newBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>{editingId=null;creating=true;clearError();render();const first=list.querySelector('input');if(first)first.focus();});render();const unsubscribe=api.subscribe(()=>{if(!creating&&!editingId)render();else{const ids=new Set(allTasks().map(t=>t.id));if(editingId&&!ids.has(editingId)){editingId=null;render();}}});root.addEventListener('bci:unmount',unsubscribe,{once:true});api.log(7,'Steer 2 A consumed: INLINE_EDIT');
